title: A2UI Custom Components Catalog
description: Extended catalog that includes A2UI basic components plus custom components: A2UIWeb (WebView) and MyA2UIView (simple text view).

allOf.description: A custom WebView component that loads and displays web content from a URL. Registered via registerCustomRenderView on the client side.

source.description: The URL of the web page to load and display in the WebView.

allOf.description: A simple custom view that displays text with a configurable color. Registered via registerCustomRenderView on the client side.

text.description: The text content to display in the custom view.

textColor.description: The color of the text. Format: CSS hex color code (e.g., '#6200EE', '#333333').

weight.description: The relative weight of this component within a Row or Column. This is similar to the CSS 'flex-grow' property. Note: this may ONLY be set when the component is a direct descendant of a Row or Column.
